visual.description: The soft blue-grey gradient background of the hero section featuring the aircraft and sky.
Very dark near-black used for the dark sections (Flexible Services panel, footer, mobile app section).
Pure white background used for the main content sections (features grid, destinations, experience).
Very light off-white/grey used as a subtle alternate section background.
Primary heading colour used for large display headings on light backgrounds.
White heading text used on dark/navy backgrounds.
Pure black body copy colour used in feature descriptions and paragraph text.
Medium grey used for secondary descriptive text, country labels, and footer nav links.
The nav bar in its top-of-page state appears transparent, overlaying the hero — nav text is dark #000d10.
Navigation link colour in the transparent (top-of-page) state.
After scroll the nav resolves to white/light background with dark text.
Navigation link colour in the scrolled (opaque) state.
Near-black pill buttons used for primary CTAs like 'All Solutions' and 'Ownership' on dark backgrounds.
White label text used on primary dark pill buttons.
Warm terracotta/clay accent colour used as the Ownership panel background in the Flexible Services section.
Light grey used for divider lines between feature cards in the destinations and feature grids.
Outline/ghost pill button with black border and text, used for 'Book a flight' and 'Contact us' CTAs.
